abstract: Research on the delay measurement method of satellite antenna receiving link, design the test methods by the identical frequency system and the variable frequency system, innovatively use four-port network analyzer and the pulse modulation method to measure the delay of variable frequency system. Simultaneously use the network analyzer transfer coefficient and the time interval counter with the identical frequency system. Then choose X band satellite antenna to qualify the result. Furthermore measure the delay segmentally, which the whole system can be divided into three parts according to the signal transmission. Lastly fulfill the whole link measurement of Nanosecond delay. The paper provide the data-correctional of delay model in accurately orbit control, deep-space exploration and other major scientific test tasks and so on, at the same time put forward new ideas about delay measurement of the variable frequency system, which have high practicability and generalization.

articleTitle: Research of ATS architecture based on Information Path
publicationTitle: IEEE 2011 10th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: With the widely used of micro-electronics and bus technology, ATS (automatic test system) has got rapid development in the test of all kinds of instruments. The research of architecture of ATS can effectively drive the development and amelioration of ATS. Based on the correlative information of auto test process, the paper puts forward the architecture of IPATS (Information Path-based ATS). In this architecture, ATS information path is divided into six information modules. In the form of a combination of establishment of common switch channel and information description of path configuration, switch subsystem is mathematically modeled to get the sub-system design based on information path.

articleTitle: Effect of Ar/O2 gas ratio and annealing temperature on the structure and properties of ZnO film
publicationTitle: IEEE 2011 10th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Zinc oxide (ZnO) film is deposited on Si (001) substrate by radio-frequency (RF) reactive magnetron sputtering method. Then the samples are annealed at different temperatures. The effects of the ratio of Ar/O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and annealing temperature are investigated. Crystal structures of the films are characterized by X-ray diffraction (XRD) and atomic force microscopy (AFM). The results indicate that the ratio of Ar/O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and the annealing temperature have great influence on the crystal orientation and the surface morphology. The crystalline orientation of ZnO thin film is in direct proportion to the Ar/O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas ratio. While less than 750°C;, the crystal orientation of ZnO thin film increases with the annealing temperature increasing. As higher than 750°C, the crystalline orientation of ZnO thin film is inversely proportional to the annealing temperature.

articleTitle: Multi-target tracking-based detection of floc settling velocity
publicationTitle: IEEE 2011 10th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: In the automatic control of coagulant dosage in water plant, the final control performance mainly depends on the chosen of control parameters. In this paper, a multi-target tracking-based detection system for floc settling velocity is proposed. The system collects floc dynamic change images online by using an underwater image sensor, and transmits the images to computer image processing system. Therefore the flocs characteristics and their settling velocities will be calculated through image processing and multi-target tracking. Finally, extraction and analysis of floc feature characteristics can be achieved. The system uses Kalman filter and multiple hypothesis tracking (MHT) algorithms to calculate the flocs settling velocities. Weighted average floc settling velocity can be calculated by weighted mathematical statistics. Experimental results show that using of detection system can reflect the floc sedimentation status underwater, and average floc settling velocity is within 0.08 ~ 0.140 mm/s. This system provides an effective control parameter, floc settling velocity, for the automatic control of coagulant dosage.

articleTitle: Graph and information based intelligent design for testability
publicationTitle: IEEE 2011 10th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The cost effectiveness of fault detection and isolation techniques used in complex systems is paid more attention in nowadays. Well design for testability (DFT) can save cost in fault detection and isolation, assure adequate failure coverage by Built-In Test (BIT) and Automatic Test Equipment (ATE), reduce false alarms, and reduce maintenance training requirements. However, there are limited intelligent approaches implemented and applied for DFT for integrated diagnostics. Meanwhile, different tools for DFT are incompatible with each other. This phenomenon has prevented testability engineering from integrating into system engineering. The paper promotes a general-purpose graph and information based intelligent approach to DFT supporting concurrent system engineering. Testability models, including information flow model, multi-signal flow model, hybrid dependency model, etc, can all be described by a graph theory core with information attached. Meanwhile, intelligent algorithms are imported to solve complex testability inference problems, most of which are NP problems. The testability figures of merit (TFOMs) defined in IEEE 1522 are adopted to standardize the quantitative parameters to assess the testability level. An intelligent DFT framework is constructed according to AI-ESTATE to realize artificial intelligent information exchanges. The graph and information based intelligent approach is shown to be efficient and effective to realize advanced DFT of complex large systems. The transitive closure algorithm and the logical closure algorithm given in the paper is verified by the example of an electronic equipment with 4 test items and 5 fault modes. The genetic algorithms (GAs) based fault detection rate (FDR) allocation method is applied in a 3 layers' certain electronic system composed of 6 subsystems. By comparing with experience and fault rate based TFOMs allocation method, GAs is shown to be more adaptive and efficiency.

articleTitle: The technology of output signal photoelectric conversion in photonic crystal fiber pressure sensor
publicationTitle: IEEE 2011 10th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Photoelectric detector is the interface devices between the optical and electronic systems in the photoelectric information conversion system. The basic sensitive principle is analyzed in photonic crystal fiber pressure sensors, and the photonic crystal fiber pressure sensor systems and detection system based on strength decoding are designed, beside considering the sensor output signal current value is small, so the InGaAs / InP-APD photodetectors which is in accordance with the performance parameter of photodetector are chosen as the basic devices in the photoelectric conversion. The output signals are amplified by use of pre-signal amplification circuit and dual op amp differential input amplifier circuit. The output signals are detected and the changes of the external pressure are rapidly monitored by the designed detectors and the amplifier circuit.

articleTitle: Research on method of LED-induced chlorophyll fluorescence spectrum and image information acquisition
publicationTitle: IEEE 2011 10th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: In order to solve insufficiency of information content and resolution with chlorophyll fluorescence spectrometry, a method of LED-induced chlorophyll fluorescence analysis fused image processing technique is presented. Using small, long life and high-intensity blue (460nm) LED lamp for the near field detection, plants leaf fluorescence is induced actively based on the theory of active-inducing chlorophyll fluorescence. The method of extracting chlorophyll fluorescence characteristics is studied, by using spectrometer and image sensor fixed filter to obtain spectra and image information respectively. Through analyzing chlorophyll fluorescence spectra data and image data, the results indicate that fluorescence information and chlorophyll content have strong correlation. This research lays the foundation for living body real-time online measurement in situ.

articleTitle: Sine wave algorithm based on 2nd offset and its implementation in FPGA
publicationTitle: IEEE 2011 10th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Sine function is widely used in many modern application fields. Many schemes were proposed to generate sine wave. Among the methods Look-Up Table is the simplest and fastest one. Many efforts have been carried out to reduce the memory size of the LUT. In this paper comparison among offsets of 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th is executed to search the best one. A Direct Digital Frequency Synthesizer (DDFS) was designed to verify the proposed 2nd offset sine algorithm using Field Programmable Gates Array (FPGA), Digital to Analog Converter and low pass filter. The experiment demonstrates that 2nd offset sine algorithm can reduce the memory size greatly.

articleTitle: Multi-rate system performance comparison with the role of anti-interference and encrypted
publicationTitle: IEEE 2011 10th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: In this paper, DS / CDMA (code division DS) system with anti-interference and the role of data encryption, multi-rate signal transmission of several programs to Rayleigh fading channel transmission, for example, narrowband and wideband CDMA based channel Rayleigh number of different paths, indicating a multi-rate signal system, different programs have different results, by software simulation shows that, OVFS scheme in Rayleigh fading channels under its multi-channel processing gain and the number of fading paths on encryption performance of multi-rate systems have a major impact, broadband system encryption performance is better than narrowband systems. Multi-modulation is also a feasible option, but it handles the user's high-speed data encryption performance is significantly worse than other programs.

articleTitle: Study on exploratory factor analysis in measurement information extraction and reconstruction
publicationTitle: IEEE 2011 10th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: In order to explore the potential association of various factors in actual measurement data, the principle of exploratory factor analysis was discussed in the paper and its application for the measurement information mining was explored to implement the synthesis and simplification of original multivariate plane data. Firstly, the correlation analysis of original variable and the extraction of common factors were executed. Secondly, the factor matrix was calculated to obtain the physical significance of common factors. Finally, the factor score coefficient matrix was obtained by virtue of the regression analysis, which can combine and synthesize the relevant variable to realize the extraction and reconstruction of measurement information. The simulation experiment testified the validity of the model. However, the reasonable selection of the extraction method of common factor and the quantitative criterion still need further research.

articleTitle: Electronic fiber seal and the analysis of its vulnerability
publicationTitle: IEEE 2011 10th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Seal is one important technology in the fields of nuclear disarmament verification, international nuclear safeguard and nuclear non-proliferation, and so on. This article studies the operating principle of electronic fiber seal, explicitly points out the key technology of a certain electronic fiber seal, and analyzes its possible existing vulnerability, which will lay a solid foundation for the improvement of seal tamper-proof ability and its application.

articleTitle: The study on measuring point selection of transformer vibration monitoring
publicationTitle: IEEE 2011 10th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: The selection of measuring points is an important problem for the vibration monitoring of transformers. The paper analyses the corresponding selecting principles. A series of experiments were conducted in one 220kV transformer with fixed-frequency variable current. The experimental results showed that the measuring points should be placed on the base of windings and the side wall of the tank. Another experiment was conducted with variable-frequency fixed-current. The results showed that different exciting frequency was important for choosing measuring points. Finally, three selecting principles were summarized.

articleTitle: Research of correlation on calibrating and comparing equipments
publicationTitle: IEEE 2011 10th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: For high precision measurement, this paper introduces the correlation principle on calibrating and comparing equipments. Frequency comparing equipments' sensitivity, phase comparing system and double mixing time difference (DMTD) system's self-calibration can be realized by using auto-correlation principle. Calibration of measuring equipments can be done by using cross-correlation principle. Study and application in time and frequency domain measurement is expatiated by instances using correlation principle. From the measured data, it proves that the method improves the stability test of reliability.

articleTitle: Network with random time delay based optimal feedback control of the heating stove systems
publicationTitle: IEEE 2011 10th International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments
abstract: Network based optimal feedback control of the heating stove is presented in this paper. At first, the mathematical model of the network based heating stove system is established. Then the network delay time predictive using time-stamped BP neural network method is proposed. This is followed the discrete state equations based on predicted network delay time value. Finally, an optimal state feedback controller using the Kalman filter state estimation technique and Liapunov stability theory is designed. Simulated responses are presented in this paper to highlight the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

Author Keywords: Networked control with random time delay
